::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
IIT Madras spin-off building RISC-V based SoCs. Among the first Indian startups to tape out a production-ready RISC-V chip.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Secure IoT SoCs based on RISC-V architecture with built-in hardware security features. The Secure IoT chip targets smart metering, industrial automation, and connected devices.
